subject: Request: Aurum Labs onramp bundle (credits + discount) — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurumlabs.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request — onramp package: additional credits + 30% promotional discount

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Aurum is excited about the latency profile and the console observability. Procurement and engineering chatted this morning and asked whether we can move forward this quarter if you can do two things on the onramp bundle:

1) Add a one-time 200k token credit to the POC (we were initially quoted 50k).
2) Apply a 30% promotional discount on the first 3 months of committed usage to help justify spend to leadership.

We understand these are bigger asks than standard, but Aurum is willing to sign a 12-month committed plan tied to the POC success metric (3M tokens/month minimum after Q1). Procurement (cc'd) requested the ask be routed to your execs for exception approval.

Attached is our procurement checklist and the initial SOW draft — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Alex Nguyen\Lead, Platforms\Aurum Labs
Attachments: Aurum_Procurement_Checklist.pdf, SOW-draft-Aurum.docx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurumlabs.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — onramp package: additional credits + 30% promotional discount

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for the SOW.

Short answer: this goes to an executive exception because the token credit and a 30% promo for three months exceeds standard onramp sweeteners. I will escalate internally now and aim to get back by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm legal wants the SOW redlineable (yes/no)? Also: is the 12-month commit firm on your end or conditional on the POC hitting the success metric?

I'll loop in Marissa and Aditya for approval routing and Jonas for the finance carveout.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman\Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurumlabs.io>, Sofia Petrov <sofia.petrov@aurumlabs.io>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request — onramp package: additional credits + 30% promotional discount — Exec approval request

Team — forwarding Aurum's ask. TL;DR: Prospect requests a one-time 200k token credit (we quoted 50k) + 30% discount on months 1–3. In exchange Aurum will sign a 12-month commitment with 3M tokens/mo minimum after Q1 (they say this is firm; attached SOW).

Why this is time-sensitive: procurement would like to close this quarter; Aurum is a strategic early-adopter account in retail analytics and will be a public win if we can secure them quickly.

My recommendation (based on similar deals): approve a blended concession: one-time 125k token credit + 20% discount months 1–2 (not 3) and require the 12-month commit with staged SLA/usage milestones. Finance impact estimate in HubSpot (link below) shows ~28% IRR hit in year 1 but positive LTV in year 2.

Please review and indicate: APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CHANGES / DECLINE. If APPROVE, detail any guardrails (expiry, phased credit release, reporting cadence).

Context and links: HubSpot deal DL-2026-0847 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6473821)
Attachments: Aurum_Onramp_Proposal_v3.pdf, SOW-draft-Aurum.docx

—Naomi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurumlabs.io>, Sofia Petrov <sofia.petrov@aurumlabs.io>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request — onramp package: additional credits + 30% promotional discount — Exec approval request

Thanks Naomi — I reviewed the proposal and the revenue/finance notes. I approve a limited exception with these conditions:

1) One-time 125k token credit to be released in two tranches: 75k at contract signature, 50k after completion of POC acceptance testing.
2) Promotional discount: 20% on months 1–2 only (not month 3). No promotional stacking.
3) Require the 12-month commitment to be contractually firm with a minimum monthly consumption floor of 2.5M tokens after month 3; include a true-up clause.
4) Legal to review SOW redlines; any carveouts on data residency or SLA must be escalated to security.

Jonas — please confirm accounting treatment and revenue recognition impact. Aditya — happy for you to finalize commercial language with Naomi and coordinate the signature timeline.

Marissa Cole\Head of Revenue | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurumlabs.io>, Sofia Petrov <sofia.petrov@aurumlabs.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 16:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — onramp package: additional credits + 30% promotional discount

Alex / Sofia — good news: leadership has approved a limited exception. Summary of approved terms below (final language to be in SOW):

- One-time token credit: 125,000 tokens (split: 75,000 at signature, 50,000 after POC acceptance).
- Promotional discount: 20% off invoice months 1 and 2 only. No discount on month 3.
- Commitment: 12 months with a 2.5M tokens/month minimum after month 3; true-up clause included.
- Conditions: SOW to be redlined by legal; security to sign off on any SLA/data residency carveouts.

I've attached the revised proposal and a redline-ready SOW for your legal team. If that aligns, can you confirm (A) acceptance of the staged credit release and (B) that the 12-month commitment is firm? Once confirmed, we'll issue the final order form for signature.

Thanks — excited to get Aurum onboarded.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman\Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Aurum_Onramp_Proposal_v3-Approved.pdf, SOW-draft-Aurum-redline.docx
